source.title: Question intake digest — unresolved clusters
source.body:
# Question intake digest — unresolved clusters 5 open question intake(s), of which **2 form 1 cluster(s)**. One answer per cluster clears the cluster; answering per question is how the pile grows faster than it drains. ## Clusters (answer once) | cluster | questions | shared vocabulary | |---|---|---| | @#3298, #3304 | 2 | `bounded`, `capability`, `descriptions`, `fail`, `false`, `last`, `refresh`, `registry` | ## Claimable tasks Each genuine-gap cluster has a `[Bounty]` task linked to it. **$0 / `zero-bounty` by design**: the reward is merge credit, a leaderboard entry and a line in the Hall of Fame, and a real bounty exists only when someone funds it with `/reward ` (`JOIN.md` § Bounties & payment). - #3298 anchor · 2 question(s) · `#3298, #3304` ## By measured coverage - **genuine gaps** (no lesson reaches them): 5: #3304, #3301, #3299, #3298, #3296 - **already covered** (a lesson is reached, so this is retrieval or phrasing): 0 - **not measured** (endpoint unreachable — *not* a coverage claim): 0 ## What automation cannot do here Writing the answer. A generated answer to a question about a platform nobody here has run is an invented source, which is the one failure this repository has a gate for. The automation's job is to make the human step as small as possible: cluster it, measure it, ask the reporter for the missing pieces, and never leave them in silence. Regenerated by `scripts/question_autopilot.py` (`.github/workflows/question-autopilot.yml`).
This repo is using Opire - what does it mean? 👇
💵 Everyone can add rewards for this issue commenting /reward 100 (replace 100 with the amount).
🕵️‍♂️ If someone starts working on this issue to earn the rewards, they can comment /try to let everyone know!
🙌 And when they open the PR, they can comment /claim #3333 either in the PR description or in a PR's comment.

🪙 Also, everyone can tip any user commenting /tip 20 @github-actions[bot] (replace 20 with the amount, and @github-actions[bot] with the user to tip).
